metadata.version_label: 3.1 (amendment PRE-004) with the 2026-10-08 update (PRE-004 C21, C23 shared-cohort check; triage provenance fields; PRE-009) - release v3.3 pending
metadata.status: empty template; no included studies or extraction records (v3.1, amendment PRE-004)
metadata.note: blank_record null means not yet entered; after source review use NR/NA/UNCLEAR. blank_record structures are identical, field for field and in order, to data_dictionary.json relational_model.table_specs (checked by script).
metadata.field_count_note: The 61 legacy source fields are retained and mapped (no legacy table or column renamed); the operational schema adds relational, donor-count, assay-universe, candidate-selection, supplement-traceability, digitization and, in v3, open-window organising-construct fields (marker family, window position, exposure as reported, adult-stratum separability, author window interpretation). v3.1 (PRE-004) appends one optional column, precision_validation.marker_family, at the end of that table; no column is renamed or removed. The 2026-10-08 update appends two copy-only columns at the end of reports (v_layer_validation_subtypes_from_triage, validation_element_confirmed).
metadata.organising_construct: The exercise-induced immune "open window" is an organising construct only: it defines the post-exercise period after an identifiable bout (organising window 0-72 h after cessation, 72 h inclusive), the sampling time points and the marker families to be charted. The review does not test or adjudicate whether an open window exists; original authors' interpretations are charted descriptively (author_window_interpretation) and never affect eligibility or weighting.
metadata.validation_readiness_map_definition: Validation-readiness map: a per-marker, domain-by-domain descriptive profile across the seven precision domains; not a score, ranking, grade or development ladder.
metadata.excel_workbooks: Generated from this template and data_dictionary.json by scripts/build_workbooks.py (--only extraction; --reviewer A/B for per-reviewer files); CSV exports versioned in git.

controlled_vocabulary_shared.source: Verbatim copies of data_dictionary.json controlled_vocabulary.time_bin, time_bin_rules.window_position and controlled_vocabulary.scope_stream (contract 8.3f, 8.3g); the dictionary is canonical.

reports.row_unit: one report or distinguishable version (preprint, accepted manuscript, version of record, correction): one reports row per version. Version rows of one report share the stem of reference_id with a suffix (e.g. R01, R01-V1) and, once the version relationship is verified, are linked through report_cohort_links to the same study_id (study family) and cohort_id; a version stub carries bibliographic and version fields only.

cohorts.row_unit: one recruited participant cohort or separable stratum

sample_sets.row_unit: one cohort × group/arm × matrix × time point as sampled in the Methods (whether or not a result is reported for that combination); assay platforms are listed in assay_platform ("; "-separated). Split by platform only when the report gives a platform-specific n that differs between platforms at that time point; split by analysis subgroup only when subgroup n and subgroup results are reported; control-arm time points get their own rows.

measurements.row_unit: Conventional/targeted assays: one named analyte × one author-reported statistical test (one row for a time main effect across time points; one row per time-point contrast only when each contrast is the reported test). Omics: one assay_universe_summary row per analysis universe (platform × matrix × analysis route) plus one named_immune_candidate row per candidate named in the main text, main tables or figure legends; supplementary result tables are summarised in the universe row by counts and locators; candidates prespecified in the original aims/methods are always enumerated (including nulls); set-level results (pathways, modules, hit counts) as one reported_result_summary row per analysis.

precision_validation.row_unit: one report × cohort × marker_family × one domain (default: one set of seven domain rows per report × cohort × marker family, measurement_id null); an additional analyte-level row (measurement_id = one measurement ID) only for a domain where the report gives analyte-specific evidence. No rows for background reports.

referential_integrity_checks: each measurement.sample_set_ids[] resolves to sample_sets in the same cohort/study
each precision row resolves to a report and any optional measurement
Each assay_universe_id links one assay-level summary to its named candidates/result rows; preserve tested-universe and supplement locators.
Primary keys are unique, nonempty stable IDs; required linkage keys are never NR/NA/UNCLEAR.
Every sample, measurement and precision report_id/study_id/cohort_id tuple exists in report_cohort_links.
Each measurement.sample_set_ids[] belongs to its report as well as its cohort/study; optional precision measurement_id, when present, matches the same report/study/cohort.
Cohort-specific A/B membership uses report_cohort_links.scope_streams; one cohort in both streams is counted once overall.
sample_sets.within_organising_window agrees with time_bin through time_bin_window_position.
Row IDs follow M-<ref>-NNN, SS-<ref>-NN and PV-<ref>-NNN in order of appearance; no custom prefixes.
precision_validation.measurement_id is a single measurement ID or null; precision_validation.marker_family, when filled, matches the marker_family of the measurements it summarises.
guardrails: No decisions or extracted scientific values are prefilled in the empty template; under PRE-009 AI stand-in values are loaded into reviewer workbooks only, and every cell is confirmed or overwritten by B or C.
No aggregate precision score, readiness score or ranking; domain rows feed only the validation-readiness map (see the validation-readiness map definition in this file; contract 8.3e).
Participant n, biological samples, cells and technical replicates remain separate.

Immune candidates named in the main text, main tables or figure legends, and candidates prespecified in the original aims/methods, are recorded regardless of significance; supplementary result tables are summarised by counts and locators in the assay-universe row; unreported feature rows are not invented.
Figure-only values are not digitised: record direction and significance only, effect_value NR, figure_panel_locator filled, flag FIGURE_ONLY (PRE-004).

Support B (retained; cross-bout open-window monitoring layer) requires same marker + same participants across >=2 distinct bout_id values, known timing and baseline/comparator; deduplicated against Core A by cohort_id.
Samples later than 72 h after cessation are extracted and tagged outside_window_recovery; nothing is excluded for falling outside the 0-72 h organising window.
Exercise duration and intensity are recorded as reported and never used as eligibility thresholds.
Only adults (>= 18 y) or separable adult strata are charted; older adults are flagged as a subgroup.
Author open-window interpretation is a descriptive tag; it never affects eligibility or weighting.
Background reports are charted at reduced depth (bibliographic, design, population, platforms, n), with no per-marker results and no precision_validation rows; one extractor plus one checker.
Screening and consensus fields are copied from the locked screening records only; no eligibility opinion is written into them.
Count fields hold integers or bare missing codes; explanations go to notes.

Triage provenance (reports.v_layer_validation_subtypes_from_triage) and the full-text field validation_element_confirmed are copy-only; a V report with validation_element_confirmed = no is kept, charted and flagged, not excluded (2026-10-08).
